description: Whether Forward from Gmail automatically is offered and on, and the link the person opens to turn it on with one Allow tap, on any device. Instead of a Gmail filter, TrackerHacker then picks up mail from the person's hacks' senders in their Gmail within seconds of it arriving (senderList), plus up to 25 such emails from the last 30 days. It opens only those messages and stores none; it is not a way to read their email (for that, use your own Gmail connection). Save the hack before giving the link, so the person sees their sheet fill. Only they can tap Allow. To turn it off, stop_gmail_forwarding.
name: gmail_forwarding
title: Forward from Gmail automatically
